## 🚀 Day-1 Operator Onboarding & 60-Second Triage Guide
If you are opening this repository for the first time or starting a desk shift, read the **Operator
Quickstart, Data Cleaning Pipeline & 10-Mode Action Runbook** and open the **Live 6-Tab Surveillance
, ROT Bet-Ticker & 10-Mode Forensic Portal (`graph.html`)**.
Always use **`./bin/dx`** as your primary entrypoint—it configures sandbox/host `$HOME/.gitconfig`,
links your dotfiles checkout (`$DX_DOTFILES_DIR`, else `~/dotfiles`; never overwriting a real file),
loads Cloudflare Pages credentials, and runs its tooling through Bun (`v1.4.4`). Run `./bin/dx help
` for every command and `./bin/dx scripts` for the grouped `package.json` scripts:

place with a dotfiles symlink; `--replace` moves it to `<path>.dx-backup-<epoch>` and links.
- `./bi
n/dx scripts [substring]` — the `package.json` scripts grouped by prefix; a substring lists the matc

hing commands.
- `./bin/dx gslive <LOGIN>` — GSLive Partner 118 links for one account: the 7-paramet
er `#/reports/users` deep link (`bot=true`, desk-day ISO window, `text=player_<LOGIN>`) and the `#/e

vents/bet-history` sidecar (`calcTime` / `betTime`, epoch `from`/`to`, raw `partnerUserId`).
- `./bi

n/dx docs` / `./bin/dx docs gslive` — deployed docs portal URLs, or the GSLive surface section.
- `.
/bin/dx stale -i <export>` — stale-line cohort over a bet-log export (CSV/JSON/JSONL); seeds on oper
ator stale notes or graded-then-cancelled tickets, then clusters other customers on the same market

and window.

## Pinned Bun compatibility tests

Tests distinguish Fetch-spec requirements from behavior observed on Bun 1.4.4.
The pinned `Request`

constructor retains GET/HEAD bodies and accepts spec-forbidden
methods. It also maps mixed-case `Del

ete` to `GET` and uppercases custom verbs.
These are compatibility differences, not application guar

antees: use explicit
uppercase methods. `fetch` rejects nonempty GET/HEAD bodies before transmission

ntees: use explicit
uppercase methods. `fetch` rejects nonempty GET/HEAD bodies before transmission.

String request bodies have no inferred Content-Type on this binary, and JSON
Blobs acquire `charset=

utf-8`. Wire tests check explicit Content-Type headers
separately so application behavior does not d
epend on those inferences.

Subprocess fixtures await output writes and exit naturally while the parent
drains stdout and stderr

concurrently. They assert complete byte content rather
than assuming unread pipes always deadlock o
r enforcing machine-speed thresholds.
## Runtime Architecture & Server Policies
### Security Headers & Telegram Mini App Embedding
To ensure seamless embedding inside Telegram Web (`https://web.telegram.org`), Telegram mobile apps,
and desktop clients without frame hijacking vulnerabilities:
- `X-Frame-Options` is **strictly absent** from all server response headers (the deprecated `ALLOWAL

L` directive is never sent).
- Embedding is governed exclusively by modern standards: `Content-Secur
ity-Policy: frame-ancestors 'self' https://web.telegram.org https://*.telegram.org telegram:;`.
